title: Amazon ASIN Rating & Review Count Scraper

asins.title: ASINs or product URLs
asins.description: One per line, or paste a whole spreadsheet column. Accepts bare ASINs (B0G7RYP439) or product links (https://www.amazon.de/dp/B0GDHRZFWH). A link is scraped on its own marketplace, so one run can mix countries. Duplicates and non-ASIN cells are skipped automatically.

marketplace.title: Marketplace for bare ASINs
marketplace.description: Which Amazon store to use for bare ASINs. Product links always use their own store.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel sessions
maxConcurrency.description: How many products are fetched at once (each with its own IP and cookies). Default 40. It is capped automatically to fit the run memory and slows down by itself if Amazon pushes back.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: The defaults work for almost everyone.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Default: fast Apify datacenter proxies, switching to residential only for products that keep getting blocked. Change this only if you want to force a proxy group or use your own proxies.

debugHtml.title: Save raw pages (debug)
debugHtml.description: Store each fetched page in the run's key-value store so you can inspect what Amazon returned. Leave off for normal use.

description: Paste ASINs or Amazon product links and click Start. Each product returns its star rating, total ratings count, title and link. Results are in the Output tab (Excel, CSV, JSON).
